falseSynonyms.zh: 去年不等於幾年前 last year 只表示上一年，時間比 a few years ago 更近。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I moved here last year. I moved here a few years ago.

falseSynonyms.zh: 幾年後不等於幾年前 years later 表示之後發生，方向和 ago 相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She moved away a few years ago. She returned years later.

falseSynonyms.zh: 很久以前不等於幾年前 long ago 通常表示很久以前，時間距離往往比 a few years ago 更遠。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The castle was built long ago. The museum opened a few years ago.

falseSynonyms.zh: 最近不等於幾年前 recently 表示不久前，通常比「幾年前」更接近現在。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I saw him recently. I met him a few years ago.

falseSynonyms.zh: 今年較早時不等於幾年前 earlier this year 仍然屬於今年內。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She changed jobs earlier this year. She moved abroad several years ago.

falseSynonyms.zh: 幾年後不等於幾年前 in a few years 表示未來。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We moved here a few years ago. We may move again in a few years.

falseSynonyms.zh: 持續幾年不等於幾年前 for a few years 表示一段持續時間，而不是某個過去時間點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I lived there for a few years. I moved there a few years ago.

falseSynonyms.zh: 參照時間不同 ago 以現在為參照點；before 或 earlier 常以另一個過去時間點為參照。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She moved here three years ago. She had lived elsewhere three years before that.
